svg.aria-label: Side view of the inside of the PixelPane shadow box, from the front: a two-way mirror, an optional diffuser, the 3D-printed light grid with one square cell per LED, and the 32x32 LED panel facing forward. Behind them, a ribbon cable runs to the Raspberry Pi 3B with an Adafruit RGB Matrix HAT, powered by a 5 V 4 A supply that plugs into the wall.
